summary: Reports a working system at Xerox in Palo Alto for sending text display information between a DEC PDP-10 running TENEX and a remote IMLAC PDS-1 display. It covers the IMLAC hardware, the facilities the user sees and the monitor calls on the TENEX side.

eli5.summary: A big computer sends words to a little screen far away. This note explains how the screen and the computer talk.
